concepts.title: 날담 — 종이 한 장
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: polished Korean mobile-app brand concept presentation board, landscape 3:2.
Brand: "날담", romanized "naldam". A warm, thoughtful app where answering one question every day and keeping a private record has independent value. Users can optionally discover others through shared interests and public stories, and have 1:1 chats. Fixed menus are 홈, 발견, 대화; do not draw app screens. Paper/envelope tactile inspiration. Design direction A: ONE PAGE OF MYSELF.
Primary request: create an ORIGINAL extremely simple, distinctive flat symbol: a softly rounded upright paper sheet, with one expressive diagonal folded corner or broad negative-space cut, suggesting a page being gently lifted. The paper silhouette must remain primary. A tiny dialogue interpretation may emerge from the cut but no separate chat bubble. Aim for an iconic compact asymmetric silhouette, substantial shapes, generous negative space, readable at 32px. Not a generic file icon: create a memorable sculpted inner curve and folded-corner geometry, no text lines inside the mark.
Composition: off-white ivory #F7F3EC clean presentation board. Upper left small label exactly "01 / PAPER". Main central upper area a large warm terracotta #BC684C symbol next to the beautiful Korean wordmark "날담", accurately spelled two syllables 날 + 담, dark espresso #3D302B, modern softly rounded but controlled Korean sans-serif lettering, no calligraphy. Beneath wordmark the small romanization "naldam". Below lockup the Korean tagline EXACTLY "오늘의 나를 담다". Lower third a horizontal strip of three aligned demonstrations of exactly the same symbol: full flat terracotta square app-icon preview with ivory mark (rounded app-corner preview); monochrome espresso mark on ivory; reversed ivory mark on espresso square. Consistent symbol in all sizes and variants. Wide breathing space, precise optically balanced alignment, editorial design presentation. Tiny palette swatches ivory, terracotta, espresso at bottom right, no hex labels.
Constraints: vector-like crisp flat artwork, not a real vector file. Absolutely no gradients, shadows, bevels, photorealism, mockup phones, textures, wax seals, hearts, extra symbols, watermarks. Do not mimic existing app logos. Only the exact words requested, no additional text. The large wordmark and symbol must be the star.

concepts.title: 날담 — 이야기를 담는 봉투
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: polished Korean mobile-app brand concept presentation board, landscape 3:2.
Brand: "날담", romanized "naldam". Product: daily question-based personal records, self-discovery, optional discovery of people through interests and selected public stories, 1:1 chat. The app must have value when used alone. Warm paper/envelope visual heritage. No app screens.
Design direction B: STORIES IN AN ENVELOPE.
Primary request: create an ORIGINAL minimal geometric logo where a single off-center page rising slightly from a rounded lower envelope pocket makes ONE unified silhouette. The envelope lower edge may end with one short restrained speech-tail angle, integrated into geometry, not an extra icon. This should communicate keeping one's daily stories and gently opening up. Two or three broad planar shapes maximum, single-color reproduction excellent. The paper extends just enough above the pocket to create a recognizable ownable silhouette; no generic mail-envelope rectangle with an X, no paper airplane, no heart, no house. Avoid fine folding lines: define the fold with one wide negative-space diagonal gap.
Composition: off-white ivory #F7F3EC landscape brand board. Upper left small label exactly "02 / ENVELOPE". Main central upper area large warm dark caramel #9B7052 symbol beside elegant Korean wordmark "날담", accurately spelled 날 + 담, dark espresso #3D302B modern rounded Korean sans-serif. Below wordmark small lowercase "naldam". Beneath the lockup tagline EXACTLY "오늘의 나를 담다". Lower third clean row with three samples of exactly the SAME mark: rounded-square app-icon preview caramel background with ivory symbol; single espresso mark on ivory; ivory on espresso square. Significant clear space, precise alignment, logo designer portfolio quality, no decorative illustration. Tiny palette swatches ivory, caramel, espresso in bottom right without labels.
Constraints: clean flat vector-like shapes only, no 3D, no shadows, no gradients, no textures, no mockup phones, no stamps, no unrelated icons, no watermark. Symbols must match exactly across demonstrations. Text only as specified. Mark must be legible at 32 pixels.

concepts.title: 날담 — 쌓이는 나의 기록
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: polished Korean mobile-app brand concept presentation board, landscape 3:2.
Brand exact Korean name "날담", lowercase romanization "naldam". Daily questions and meaningful personal journaling are core; finding people with shared interests and chatting is a natural optional extension. It is a warm modern consumer app. Envelope/paper inspiration, no app screens.
Design direction C: DAYS BECOME LAYERS.
Primary request: create an ORIGINAL compact emblem from two or three thick softly rounded paper-like ribbons/sheets slightly offset, united into a simple coherent rising silhouette. The layers imply daily records accumulating into one's identity; a quiet facing relationship in the negative space can imply conversation. Give the geometry a calm rhythm and one recognizable stepped/notched corner. Use broad forms only, visually balanced, no outlines or fine internal details, strong small-size recognizability. It must look like an ownable brand symbol rather than a generic stacked-documents toolbar icon. No infinity sign, no chain, no letter S, no people, no heart, no chat ellipsis. Three layers maximum, flat single-color-friendly.
Composition: warm ivory #F7F3EC landscape board. Upper left small label exactly "03 / LAYERS". Large muted deep olive #697657 symbol next to elegant accurate Korean wordmark "날담" (날 + 담), dark espresso #3D302B contemporary soft Korean sans-serif, generous but optically balanced spacing. Small "naldam" under the name. Tagline EXACTLY "오늘의 나를 담다". Lower third clean consistent sample row: same symbol in ivory inside muted olive rounded-square app-icon preview; one-color espresso symbol on ivory; ivory symbol on espresso square. Identical geometry in every variant. Generous empty space, professional brand design presentation with tiny ivory/olive/espresso swatches bottom right, no labels.
Constraints: flat vector-like precise clean edges, not 3D, no gradients, no shadows, no texture, no glossy effect, no phone mockups, no additional wording, no watermarks. All requested Korean words rendered accurately.
